content: Buhanya bwâbo abadwîrhe balimbira muli Siyoni, n’abâli omu murhûla oku ntondo ya Samâriya, abo barhambo b’ishanja lirhanzi omu masha­njà, enyumpa y’Israheli eri yâbo.
Mugere e Kalne, mubone; kurhenga yo mujè e Hamati, cishagala cikulu. Kandi muyandagalire e Gati omu Filistiya. Ka yo nyinjà kulusha aga mâmi? K’ecihugo câbo co cinene kulusha ecinyu?
Mucîkêbirwe oku olusiku lw’obuhanya nyuma lwashubira, mwabiduhya okuyîmika obulyâlya.
Muvâmire bwinjinjà, mudwîrhe mwalya abâna-buzi b’obusò, amanina mwayankaga omu maruli.
Mudwîrhe mwayimbira olulanga, mudwîrhe mwajirisa enzihwa aka Daudi.
Mudwîrhe mwanywêsa amamvu omu bikombe, mwacîshiga amavurha mi­njà minjà, ci murhababîri n’okushâbûka kwa Yozefu.
Co cirhumire, buno mwe mukola mwashokolera abalulizibwa, omulimbo gw’abavâmire guhwe!
Nyakasane Nyamuzinda acîgashire yênene, kanwa ka Nyakasane Nyamuzinda w’Emirhwe: «Ntakwîrirwa obucîbone bwa Yakôbo, nshomba enyumpa zâge, nkola nâhana ecishagala n’ebirimwo byoshi,
“n’omu nyumpa nguma, mukasigala bantu ikumi, banafè”.
“Hasigala basungunu bône b’okurhenza emirhumba omu nyumpa, na ba­kadôsa ociri embali omu nyumpa, mpu: Muciri banga? Ashuze, erhi: Nanga, muhulike! Izîno lya Nyamuzinda lirhankaderhwa”.
“Bulya mubwîne oku Nyakasane amârhegeka, oku buhashe bwâge, enyumpa nnene yamâhongoka, n’ensungunu yamâforhama”.
“K’ebiterusi binalibirhe oku mabuye, ka banahinge enyanya n’empanzi obu mwalenganyize olubanja, n’obushiganyanya mwabujira bululu?”
“Mudwîrhe mwacishingira Lo-Debari, mwakaziderha, mpu: K’arhali misî yîrhu yàrhuhâga Karnayimu?”
“Akabà ntyo, wâni nyumpa y’Israheli, kwo Nyakasane adesire, nkolaga nâkulerhera ishanja lyâkulibuza, kurhenga aha lusò lwa Hamati kuhika oku mugezi gwa Araba”»

footnotes.text: 6, 14 Aha lusò lwa Hamati kuhika oku mugezi gwa Araba, kwo kuderha ecihugo coshi kurhenga enyanya kuhika idako.
